mapper.select: SELECT lr.id, lr.flow_no AS flowNo, lr.leave_type AS leaveType, lr.start_date AS startDate, lr.end_date AS endDate, lr.leave_days AS leaveDays, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.submitted_at AS submittedAt, lr.approver_id AS approverId, lr.approved_at AS approvedAt, lr.approve_remark AS approveRemark FROM leave_request lr WHERE lr.user_id = #{userId} AND lr.deleted_at IS NULL AND lr.status = #{status} ORDER BY lr.submitted_at DESC, lr.id DESC
SELECT flow_no FROM leave_request WHERE flow_no LIKE CONCAT('LV-', #{date}, '-%') ORDER BY flow_no DESC LIMIT 1
